title: How do some of you remember the map/layout of Mall World so vividly?
content: I just learned about Mall World and though I dream nightly I can’t say I have been to Mall World. I feel like my dreams are usually confined to a very specific place and if I travel from that place elsewhere I have NEVER remembered the layout or map of where I was. I am generally bad at that in real life too though. I’m wondering how some people have built such elaborate maps of how mall world is built out. How do you even remember that?
